summary: Introduces handlers: tasks that only run when notified, such as restarting a service only if its configuration changed.
questions: How do I restart a service only when its config file changes?

answer_card.title: What handlers are
answer_card.answer_md: Handlers are tasks that only run when notified. Use them for operations that should happen only when something changed, such as restarting a service when a task updates its configuration, but not when the configuration is unchanged.
